identification: Retro child's tubular metal coat stand, powder-coated red, yellow and blue, 120cm high, 52cm wide, five splayed feet with black rubber tips, six hooks. Looks like a 1980s Memphis-style children's stand of the type IKEA sold (Pamono lists a similar red/yellow/blue 1980s stand as IKEA, Italian-made). Unmarked in photos, so the maker is not confirmed.
